headlines.title: How Much Of Cisco Stock's Rise Did The Business Earn?
headlines.summary: Cisco Systems (CSCO) supplies businesses and the hyperscalers building AI infrastructure with networking and security products, along with services. The company's stock climbed 92% between late July 2021 and mid-October 2026, before dividends. A rally of that magnitude makes it natural to credit a growing business. So take a guess: how much of that rise came from Cisco selling more.

headlines.title: Cisco Systems (CSCO) Unveiled 102.4T AI Networking Platforms
headlines.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS:CSCO) announced new AI networking platforms using Silicon One P200, G300 and G302 switching chips with 51.2T and 102.4T systems. The company introduced 1.6T optical modules and integrated liquid cooling aimed at high density AI data center deployments. Cisco disclosed a collaboration with NVIDIA, TE Connectivity and Amphenol to co develop a 400Gb/s per lane USFP optical module and open specification.

headlines.title: Networking Stocks Rally as Tech Rebound Lifts AI Gear Makers: Ciena and Arista Climb 4%, but Cisco Barely Moves
headlines.summary: AI data center spending is splitting networking stocks into clear winners and laggards, and the gap between Ciena, Arista, and Cisco reveals which part of the network hyperscalers are actually racing to build.

headlines.title: Price Prediction: Cisco Stock Will Trade at $200 on This Date
headlines.summary: Cisco's AI order book has management calling it a networking supercycle, and shareholders want to know if a $200 share price is the payoff. A fresh model breaks down exactly how far the rally can realistically run and what stands between today's price and that milestone.

headlines.title: Prediction: Cisco Stock Could Surprise Wall Street by 2030
headlines.summary: Cisco's CEO is calling it a networking super cycle, and the numbers behind that claim are hard to ignore. But reaching $200 by 2030 requires three specific things to go right, and at least one of them sits outside the company's control.

description: Cisco Systems, Inc. designs, develops, and sells technologies to power, help, secure, and draw insights from the internet in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, Japan, and China. The company provides data center switching; network security, identity and access management, and secure access service edge; identity and agentic security solutions; interconnects public and private wireline and mobile networks, delivering connectivity to campus, data center, and branch networks; WEBEX suite, collaboration devices, and contact center; communication platform as a service software, including perpetual licenses, subscription arrangements, and hardware solutions; network assurance and observability suite; accelerated issue resolution, software support, and hardware replacement; professional services, such as planning, design, implementation, and high-value consulting; service and support packages, financing, and managed network services; and regional, national, and international wireline carriers, webscale products, internet, and cable. It also provides wireless products, including indoor and outdoor coverage designed for seamless roaming use of voice, video, and data applications; end-to-end collaboration solutions through cloud, on-premise, or within hybrid cloud environments. In addition, it offers technical support services. The company serves businesses, public institutions, governments, and service providers. It sells its products and services directly, through systems integrators, service providers, and resellers, and distributors. It has a collaboration with NVIDIA Corporation to develop Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP), a high-density optical module pluggable transceiver. Cisco Systems, Inc. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
